book.title: Ion Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Ion girumalena

content: Lasares bowa gagalowa
Apana ebowa Lasares Betaniwa wanwanlala kero wadeno wandie. Me weaweanapa Meri ita Mata do sape waimoie.
Ita me weanapa Meri, me ipa mida ando ia asiwa esapa bonabonaua Tatamba wawa osowe memepiaubepie uwawa imba mampe wawa siniamopia iwa.
Mo nopu Lasares kero wadeno sau baiwa gagalo wanaaubeieno Iesu mampe alena wane wanase, “Tatamba, e soa nuawadawadasaiana kero wadaidasano ituleide.”

Iesu nuawadawadawa sowaida kero wadeno umanawa etene wanase, “Lasares kerowa ompa ipa mai bo, dia. Tane kero sa segalena God mukawa sabamolepio apana ewapue wadaposisapue ionoidosapu. Ita ema bedewe mo God Otopa do wadaposisapue sapaidasapu.”
Iesu Mata, me wamba Meri ita Lasares nuawadawadamode.
Tane Iesu Lasares kerowa umanawa etene mai tauwadea mampe awa insepona, dia. Me naepe wandiawo walama nata sape wankasalen.
Ita walama nata sa diantono aupe Iesu a insaisawaleidie wawe alala diamone wanase, “Tauma leuntate ana Iudia bedewe.”
Iesu epe diamodio wawe alala me waitusane waienase, “Debamamba, imanaida Iudiawo Ius apanawa eiau e onaa enane seu mampe epapabolepona baiwantoie ita e dima baiwa sape leuite aitaa waiana?”
Tane Iesu me dima dewasapia baiwaleidia umanawa diamone wanase, “Walamo omo sapawa bedewe nolawa winede. Me mida walamo leidia mai dima wawa bagorepio omepi, dia, ipawa me walama sapawa ewedie leide.
Tane apana tadino dubawa bedewe leidia wawa dima bagorepio omepi.”
Iesu aia ema wane aupe mo diamone wanase, “Somba Lasares me duwa bedewe ituawawalen. Ne me mampe anteape wadapamesapo enepiwisepi.”

Iesu Lasares ituawawalena wadia, sa ipa me boidalena umanawa wadie. Tane wawe alala gagalowa sa etane ipawaida mai atentopona, dia. Mo inseia abo Lasares di ituleidia umanawa me waipona, sa baiwa mo Iesu diane waienase, “No me ituleidia umanawa etate nuamba eulen, me mamoolepie inalepia rua.”
Mo epe insakadisantone waio Iesu benemaidamone wanase, “Lasares boidalen, mai di ituleipona, dia.
Tane e baila ne nuana eulen, ipawa ne mai tauwadea me mampe wineape sausapona, epe segalena mampee e ando ne mukana ewane sumanainaitana. Tauma leuntate me mampe Iudiawo ana.”
Iesu a wadio Tomas, ebowa da waia Ragaraga, wawe alala sosowa isiwa diamone wanase, “Sa ide, Debamamba a wadia do leuntate Iudiawo ano me do awodea epaboianepu.”
Iesu Mata Meri nata ewamopia baiwa mampo aleide
Ita Iesu wawe alala do antone bola Betani mampentoio Lasares boleno ituieno walama nataitanata diantona umanawa me benemasaieno eten.
Bola Betani Ierusalem tampeido, intawa awa kampaida.
Sa baiwa Iuswa uara Betaniwa wimone Mata Meri nata nopu bolena osowe mo wasaumoie wabadomoie waimoie.
Mata Iesu iedio umanawa etene tauwadea nosene me donsapie auwasapia awa aleidie. Tane Meri duwa wankasalen.
Mata Iesu into donsane diene wanase, “Tatamba, Lasares kerolene wandia walamawe e wiepono ne nona mai bolepona, dia.
Tane ne atentene sumanaintedina tauma wiena dima uduudu God mampe iririwaitaa eneepituwapi, mai dia.”
Me epe wadio Iesu diene wanase, “E noa bolena bo bedewe inalepie enepiwisepi.”
Iesu Mata epe diedio etene leusane wanase, “Ne ateina ne nona walama ompa osowe bolala uduudu enawisau walamawe me bo bedewe inalepie enepiwisepi.”

Mape Iesu Mata diadewasasane wanase, “Ne ipa ina bumpa wainedina. Apana bo bedewe inantopue enapuwimopua mukawa ne mainawo winede. Me mida ne bedenawo sumanaileidia, me ideita bo bedewe enepiwisepie inawinakasala wadepi, mai dia.
Ita me mida inaida donsane ne sumanainaleidia tauma ita ando wankasalepi, mai bolepi, diaida. E ema sumanaiwaitiana, ba dia?”
Mata Iesu sipoasane wanase, “Oa Tatamba, ne sumanaintedina e ipa Keriso, God Otopaida, mida God sauawaleno no inta ewaewantitana wisepona tawo emawo tauma wien.”
Me epe wane aupe ene leulene wamba Meri duwa wandio awa alene enenke apana kako awa wimone waimoia emonaiane awoantone waine me diene wanase, “Debamamba wisene e umanaa wade.”
Iesu Meri waitarawa wana umanawa etene tauwadea os enenwisene Iesu into donsapia baiwa nosene alen.
Tane Iesu mai Betaniwa odapona, dia, me Mata bauta donsanawo enedio Meri awa aleidie donsan.
Ita Iuswa Meri onieie du bedewe waimoia Meri tauwadea os enenwisene nosene aleidio ewane warorosane antoie, inseia me nopa ituienawo bo nagawa moape aleidia ke wampaa baiwa aleide.
Meri alene Iesu me anuwa wandiawo wisene me ewene wawa bumpe itulene ke mampe diene wanase, “Tatamba, Lasares kerolene wandia walamawe e wiepono ne nona mai bolepona, dia.”
Tane Iesu Meri ita me sosowa isiwa warorosane antoiena ke waie nuapareidantoio ewamone nuawa kadiidaleno waitaramone wanase,
“E Lasares naepe itulana?” Mo me sipoasane waienase, “Tatamba, winewo antate euwaeto ewaa.”
Ita Iesu do ke wan.
Tane Iuswa Iesu ke wadio ewane waienase, “Ewane, Iesu Lasares nuawadawadawaida bolena baiwa kewa wadie nuapareleide.”
Tane mo bedeuwo isiwa Iesu momoduwa wane waienase, “Me apana emawa potawa inasana atenten. Me sowaida Lasares inasapona, tane eno bolen. Dima baiwa me epe dewalen?”
Iesu Lasares bo bedewe inasadio enediwisidede

Iesu wisene Lasares bo gubawa imaala winediawo itune seu debama mampe enanabodeiena euwasaieno ewen. Ita me bo gubawa sa ewedie me bauta dewalena rua nuawa pokakadileno diamone wanase, “Seu bo nagawa itunbodae winedia koirewasano nambe alepi!” Tane apana bolena weanapa Mata Iesu diene wanase, “Tatamba, dima e no dianeiana mai dewasataa rua, dia. Bo imanamalene walama nataitanata winene etepa kadilena boawa wisepi.”
Mata Iesu epe diedio me badowa diene wanase, “Ne dieena naita e sumanaitapono e God sapawaida debamaia sabamosapono ewapona. Ne dima dieena etasiaitene baiwa e ne enabodaneiana, ba?”

Me Mata epe diaidasano aupe me apana dima diamona ruawantone seu bo itunbodae winedia koirewasaieno nambe alen. Ita Iesu raupari baiwalene pisiwane emawa iono odeno wanase, “Mako, ne Lasares raupariwantedino etee sipoasaa baiwaitiana baiwa auwaedina.
Ne atenten dima uduudu raupari mampe dieedina e sipoasaiana, mai rauparina da eteipe eipona, diaida. Tane ne sabamo epe wane auwaena apana mape eneia e ne waaubaneana sumanaiwantopua baiwa.”
Iesu Mamamba mampe epe wane aupe aiawa mukama wane wanase, “Lasares, noeaaubea!”

Ita apana bolena Iesu wana rua bo nagawa bedewee nosen. Me etepa gara euda mampe lomantone ituiena do mo mampo nosene enedie. Ita Iesu Lasares apanawa diamone wanase, “Me etepa lomaitena garawa ampe otaaubaitano alepi!”
Iuswa onioniau apanawa Iesu bosapua insaisawa wadei
Ius apanawa uara Meri wasausaie wabadowa awa mampe wimone waimoia Iesu ginasa pokawaaida Lasares mampe dewasana ewane sumanaibu me bedewe ituiena.
Tane mo bedeuwo isiwa ginasa sa ewane antone Iesu dima dewasana umanawa kutun mampe Parisi apanawa benemamoiena.

Ita mo me benemawa sa etane pirisi ionoidoa ita Parisi apanawa Iuswa eiau uduudu boru baiwa diamoieno auweiena. Tane mo auwenatue muba gagalontone inta banusaie waiase, “Apana sa no bodeitalewantitano ginasa uara pokawaau dewamodie wande! No mukamba diama epe dewaleide.

Naita no ewate eto epe nolakasalempa no apanamba uduudu me sumanaiwantopu. Ita Rom gabemaniwa no onianeia epe ewapue insepuase, Iesu warerelepio no Iuswa uduudu onamba enapuo God duwa kakaiwa ita wanwanimba kadisapue, tane do no apana eiau nolantitana mukamba wadapuaubepuo oauarantato.”
Mo epe gagalontoio bedeuwo apana ebowa Kaiapas ena sawo pirisi ionoidoalene wandia wane wanase, “E insakoa apanawa wainilana, mai dima ateitipe osowe waipona, dia!
Insenadewaitana, eulena no apana dea totaaubeto no apanamba gudubu wadepie bolepio ita no inantate wainenta.”

Kaiapas mai meba insaisawe gagalo ema wapona, dia. Me ena sa bedewe pirisi ionoidoalene wandia baiwa God insaisawa waneno apana dea Iuswa baibu bolepia wan. Ita me epe wadia walamawe mo insaisau deasaia Iesu bolepia waie waimoie. Tane God insaisawa sa Kaiapas wanena Iesu apana baibu bolepia, mai Iuswa os baibu bolepi, dia. God insaisawa ituno winedia asiasi me obampaida sonabalala Iuswa bedeuwo waimoia ita do sonabalala bola daitadawo waimoia baibu bolepi. Ita Iesu God sonabamodia uduudu baibu bolepie inamopio sumanaibu me bedewe itumpe deaidantompe waimompa.
Iuswa eiau insaisau deasaia Iesu bolepi, sa baiwa mo muba epe gagalontoia walamawe Iesu mo bedeuwointa leidia ene awoa wawe alala os do bola Eparaim sala makowa tampe antone waimoie.

Tane Iuswa Pasowa odawantopua walamawa kampaleidio apana uaraia bolauwo waimoia oda awa Ierusalemwa wimonatuwaiena. Ita mo anaanau wadia mo mai kadi do Pasowa odawa odantopu, dia. Sa baiwa mo bauta kadiu mitawia baiwa duadintopue euntopue muriwa odantopu.

Ita God duwa enedia moape etemitamita bolawa winediawo apana uaraia duadintoie euntoie Iesu wabanuwa waie banusaie muba eda waitarantoie waiase, “E ambi inseilana, Iesu oda bedewe wisepio ewata, ba dia?”

Tane pirisi debamau ita Parisi apanawa bauta Iesu wadapuitudepia umanawa badowaida waieno apana oda awa wimoia eteiena. Mo benemantone waienase, “Mida Iesu naepe wandi leidia atenlepia tauwadea mainimbo wimpie benemanepio ane wadataitudepi.”
